The '''ANs-5d "lock track" full-spectrum transceiver''' was a model of [[Full-spectrum transceiver/Legends|full-spectrum transceiver]] manufactured by [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]]. It was part of the primary [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor array]] in [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation's]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]]. Installed in the nosecone, it worked in conjunction with a [[Carbanti United Electronics/Legends|Carbanti United Electronics]] [[universal transceiver package]], a [[Melihat/Legends|Melihat]] [["Multi Imager" dedicated energy receptor/Legends|"Multi Imager" dedicated energy receptor]], and a [[Tana Ire/Legends|Tana Ire]] [[electro photo receptor]].<ref name="SWS" />
